question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q4b(ii) — Combined Gas Law: Find Final Volume
question.text:
A fixed mass of gas has the following initial conditions:

  • Pressure: P₁ = 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa
  • Volume: V₁ = 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ m³
  • Temperature: T₁ = 27 °C

The gas is then heated and allowed to expand until:

  • Pressure: P₂ = 1.8 × 10⁴ Pa
  • Temperature: T₂ = 627 °C

(ii) Calculate the final volume V₂ of the gas. (6 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Combined gas law:

Formula: P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂

Step 1 — Convert temperatures to Kelvin:

T₁ = 27 + 273 = 300 K

T₂ = 627 + 273 = 900 K

Step 2 — Rearrange for V₂:

V₂ = (P₁ × V₁ × T₂) / (T₁ × P₂)

Step 3 — Substitute:

V₂ = (1.0 × 10⁵ × 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ × 900) / (300 × 1.8 × 10⁴)

V₂ = (1.0 × 10⁵ × 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ × 900) / (5.4 × 10⁶)

Numerator: 1.0 × 10⁵ × 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ = 19.0; 19.0 × 900 = 17 100

Denominator: 300 × 1.8 × 10⁴ = 5 400 000 = 5.4 × 10⁶

V₂ = 17 100 / 5 400 000 = 3.17 × 10⁻³ m³

Physical sense check: pressure dropped by factor ~5.6 and temperature increased by factor 3 → volume should increase by ~5.6 × 3 ≈ 16.7× from 1.9 × 10⁻⁴ = 3.17 × 10⁻³ ✓
